title: Ticket to Ride First Journey - Kids Train Board Game for Families, Strategy for Children, Board Games for Kids, Family Fun for Children & Families, 2-4 Players Ages 6+, 15-30 Min | For young players, connect cities on tickets, Simplified map suits small hands, Teaches planning in 15-30 minutes
features: KIDS STRATEGY BOARD GAME: First Journey uses simplified rules to introduce children ages 6+ to collecting train cards and claiming routes in a fun starter strategy game.
EXPLORE AMERICA BY TRAIN: Claim colorful routes across a US map, collect matching train cards, and connect cities from coast to coast in a board game for kids that blends play with planning.
GOLDEN TICKET CHALLENGE: Race to complete six destination tickets and claim the Golden Ticket bonus, giving young players a clear goal that keeps each 15-30 minute game focused and fun.
FAMILY FUN FOR CHILDREN & FAMILIES: Built for 2-4 players, this kids train board game supports shared play, turn-taking, and friendly competition during family game nights at home and weekend play.

EASY TO LEARN GAMEPLAY: Streamlined rules, chunky train pieces, and a child-friendly map help ages 6 and up start quickly while building strategy for children through route planning and card management.
